subtitle: Special Subject - Design Project (AI Application for beginners)

educationalGoal: In this course, students will learn how to utilize various AI methods practically by utilizing the knowledge of AI learned in the preceding courses. The course will cover AI for text and image generation, as well as AI-based image recognition methods. In particular, by learning practical applications, students will acquire the basic skills to utilize AI in finding problems and proposing ideas to solve problems in project design activities.
advice: Based on the basic knowledge of AI already acquired in this course, students will acquire the means to actually utilize AI. Although the preceding course, Project Design I, also proposes solutions, this course proposes ideas using AI as a final assignment for generative AI, image recognition, and image judgment, so that AI can be an option as a means of actually materializing these ideas rather than just being "ideas on a desk.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge and experience learned and acquired in Project Design I and AI Fundamentals.

activityGoals.body: Acquire basic knowledge of computers and acquire the ability to use them.
Acquire basic knowledge of generative AI and acquire the ability to utilize it.
Acquire basic knowledge of image recognition and acquire the ability to utilize it.
Acquire approaches to utilize the basic knowledge learned and apply it to problem solving.

achievementLevels.ideal: ・Understand the fundamentals of generative AI and be able to utilize them for analysis and problem finding. ・Understand the fundamentals of image judgment and image recognition, and be able to propose ideas that make use of them. ・Can create programs using learned AI techniques.
achievementLevels.standard: ・Can tackle problems using generative AI. ・Able to produce programs using image judgment.

lessons.content: ■Guidance and Generative AI Provide basic guidance on AI technology and enga ge in research using generative AI.
■Generative AI and programs Students will create programs using generative A I and create a simple embedded system.
■Image generation Students will generate images using generative A I and prepare a report while confirming the issu es and problems involved.
■Image Recognition and Image Judgment Confirm basic knowledge of image recognition and image judgment, and generate an actual judgment program.
■Image Recognition and Programs Incorporate the generated image recognition prog ram into other programs.
■Final assignment Based on the theme that will be the final assign ment, students will create a work that incorpora tes image judgment.
■Reflection and self-evaluation Review and self-evaluation of this course.
